name: simulate-pension-annuity-income-boundary
why: Measured reach for the annual pension/annuity-income extraction. Existing full-corpus members cover living and survivor pensions, elected and unelected lump-sum offers, already-owned and purchased annuities, life-only and survivor payout forms, non-qualified exclusion-state carry, qualified IRA-funded contract distributions, pre-start contracts, multi-year re-entry, and all four equivalence modes.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. Reach additionally fails on a cold executable whole line inside a reached range. The record-null arm is measured in capture-disabled modes; its recipient-undefined alternative remains defensive because every positive payout has either its living owner or an alive survivor recipient under annuityPayoutFraction's anyAlive gate. Direct coordinator tests pin the hand-worked Pub 939 result, full qualified-payment income character, capture-gated record construction and input-map purity; the hostile delegation test separately proves exact output selection, commit-row consumption, object identity across years, runtime journaling and cash-flow forwarding.
